review.assessment: This diff introduces a new `retry` function in `solution.py` that loops up to `attempts`, calls the given function, and returns immediately on success. When an attempt raises, the code catches it and executes `pass`, leaving the loop to finish naturally. This violates the explicit requirement to re-raise the exception from the final attempt when all retries fail.
